get.description:
Get admin data.

returns a JSON array of admin data rows.
Registry-backed for `tables`, live posture findings for `posture`,
recent DDL audit entries for `audit`. Cross-env via `target_env_id`
requires `sentin8:sys:admin` (handlers::TargetEnvQuery validation applies).
Fetch admin data.

Audit.list .

DDL audit log (Stories).
Handle audit log.

post.description:
Each row is split per design : `env_id` system column, the full JSON
body into `data`, and any keys matching a declared typed column into that
column. Typed columns are resolved from the physical table schema at
insert time.
Handle insert.

insert rows with mandatory system columns.

Data.query .

query rows with filters, sorts, pagination.
Soft-deleted rows (`deleted_at IS NOT NULL`) are excluded.
Handle query.

get.description:
Posture.get .

RLS drift detection (Stories).
Handle posture.

Table.list .

list active tables for the resolved env.
List tables.

post.description:
Creates the physical PostgreSQL table with the mandatory system column set
(`id`, `env_id`, `data` JSONB, `created_at`, `updated_at`,
`resource_version`, `deleted_at`), enables + forces RLS, creates the four
env-scoped policies, registers the table in `table_registry`, writes the
`create` DDL audit row, and emits the `sentin8:db:table:created` event -
registry, audit, and event all in the SAME transaction as the domain
change.
Create table.

create a table with mandatory system columns + RLS.

pending-delete then drop (Stories).

together - a failed DROP rolls the registry status back.
Handle drop table.

The `GET /v1/admin/{resource}` rows payload: the per-resource row
documents the RFW DataTable renders (row cells and per-resource
column sets are service-defined; the RFW renderer reads them
dynamically).

AdminUiResponse.description:
The response from an admin UI endpoint.

- `GET /v1/admin/ui/{page}` → `AdminUiResponse::Page(page_def)`
- `POST /v1/admin/{resource}` → `AdminUiResponse::Page(updated_page_def)` or `AdminUiResponse::Redirect(route)`

AlterTableRequest.description:
`POST /v1/tables/{id}/alter` - safe schema alteration (ADD COLUMN only).
Env-scoped; audited + event emitted in the same transaction.
Request body for altertable.

ColumnDef.description: One column definition of a created table.

ContainerDirection.description: Layout direction for a container's children.

CreatePolicySetBody.description:
`POST /v1/admin/policy-sets` - create a tenant policy set (name in body).
The RFW create form is POST-only and cannot PUT to a path with
the name; the shared `put_policy_set` core runs with `origin='tenant'`
validation, then the renderer is redirected to the editor page.

DeleteRequest.description:
`POST /v1/data/delete` - soft-delete rows by filter (`deleted_at = now`).
No hard-delete fallback: physical removal happens only via the controlled
drop flow.
Request body for delete.

FieldCondition.description: A visibility condition for a form field.

equals.description: The value that must match for this field to be visible.

field.description: The key of the field whose value to check.
The form field key the error refers to.

message.description: The validation message shown under the field.

FormFieldOption.description: One choice of a select-type form field.

custom_message.description: Message overriding the default validation error.

pattern.description: Regex pattern the value must match.

FormMethod.description: HTTP method used for form submission.

LiveHealth.description:
The `GET /v1/health` liveness payload every service returns: the
status string, the serving service's short name, build identity, and
(when the process tracks them) the count of live connections.
`service` and `active_connections` stay absent when a service does
not set them (e.g. the bus mounts the generic handler).

active_connections.description: Live socket count when the traffic counter is mounted.

service.description:
The serving service's short name (absent when the generic handler
does not carry one).

after.description:
Keyset cursor (DB-3, db README §7): return rows strictly after this
`id`. Takes precedence over `offset` when set - stable under inserts
between pages, unlike the offset window. Paired with `sort` on `id`
enforced server-side when the cursor is used.

PolicyDecisionRow.description: One recent deny / would-deny decision feed row.

enforced.description: Whether the deny was enforced (vs shadow-mode).

policy_set.description: The policy set that produced the decision.

subject.description: The subject the decision was about.

enabled.description: Whether the set is enabled after the flip.

mode.description: The evaluation mode after the flip.

PolicySetDetail.description: One policy set in the detail view (adds the full policy text).

enabled.description: Whether the set participates in evaluation.

policies.description: The full policy text (Shield policy language).

schema.description: Optional schema text bound to the set.

mode.description: The evaluation mode after the mutation.

PolicySetRow.description: One policy set in the list view (the RFW row shape).

enabled.description: Whether the set participates in evaluation.

id.description: The set name; doubles as the RFW row id.

policies_len.description: Number of policy statements in the set.

PolicyTestOutcome.description: A dry-run (test) outcome; nothing was stored.

policy_set_name.description: The set name the candidate text was compiled under.

would_deny.description: Whether the shadow evaluation would deny.

PrincipalAttr.description: One principal attribute in the list view.

attr_value.description: The attribute value (free-form JSON by contract).

filters.description: Opaque filter expression (the server interprets per table).

next_cursor.description:
Keyset cursor (DB-3): the last returned row's `id` - pass it back as
`pagination.after` to fetch the next page. `null` when the page was
the last (fewer rows than `limit` returned).

rows.description: The matched rows as JSON objects.

RelationRecordRow.description: One relation tuple in the list view.
